settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: We deliver nationwide across Pakistan in 2 to 4 working days via express courier service.

settings.question: Do you offer Cash on Delivery (COD)?
settings.answer: Yes! Cash on Delivery is available for all addresses across Pakistan.

settings.question: What is your exchange policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 7-day easy exchange window. If your size or fit is not right, simply message our team on WhatsApp and we will replace it for you.

settings.question: How do I choose my size?
settings.answer: Check our Size Guide on each product page for exact garment dimensions. If you prefer a loose, relaxed fit, we suggest sizing up.

settings.question: Can I place an order via WhatsApp?
settings.answer: Yes! Send us a message on WhatsApp with the item name, your size, and your delivery address, and we will place the order for you.

settings.question: How do I care for heavyweight cotton garments?
settings.answer: Wash inside out with cold water. Hang to air dry. Do not iron directly over printed details or high-density graphics.
